name: Hellspur Posse Boss — "Other outlaws you control" means Assassins, Mercenaries, Pirates, Rogues and Warlocks
notes: Found by tests/sweep.py. 'Outlaw' is a batch of five creature types, not a type itself, so the filter tokenizer treated it as an unknown subtype and filterReferencesPermanents rejected the sentence. The tokenizer now has an outlaw check (OUTLAW_CREATURE_TYPES in cards-text-utils.js). The Rogue gains haste; the Bear does not.
